identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Make provider inference readiness explicit and truthful

values.task_boundary: Implement the residual provider/model inference-readiness truth model and focused deterministic projection proof only.
deliverables: Consistent resident Shepherd and dynamic-agent roster/API projection
Focused deterministic state-matrix and production-credit tests
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: A serialized closed taxonomy defines unimplemented, unavailable, model_loading, failed, and ready
AC-2: Only ready inference is communication-eligible and receives healthy/available projection
AC-3: Resident Shepherd recovery distinguishes unsupported adapter, unavailable provider/model, failed probe, loading, and ready
AC-4: Dynamic-agent refresh retains and projects concrete verification failure semantics instead of a boolean
AC-5: Agent sample, roster entry, and detail projection preserve one inference state without identity drift
AC-6: Missing or placeholder production adapters receive no ready credit
AC-7: Focused deterministic tests, formatting, diff hygiene, and independent exact-head review pass
AC-8: Validation performs no live Runtime, provider, credential, spend, or cloud mutation
dependencies: Issue #640 / PR #653 resident Shepherd model-backed execution baseline
Issues #622 and #648 provider profile reload baseline
non_goals: No provider implementation or credential changes
No canonical identity or dynamic lifecycle redesign
No Observatory UI or Runtime v2 changes
No live deployment, restart, provider inference, or cloud work
